lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Welcome to Northwind security. When you're ready, pick a chapter and press Play.
lines.spoken: Welcome to Northwind security. When you're ready, pick a chapter and press Play.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Hey, it's Maya, your SOC lead. Welcome to your first night shift at Northwind.
lines.spoken: Hey, it's Maya, your SOC lead. Welcome to your first night shift at Northwind.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Quick tour while it's quiet. Point your controller at things and pull the trigger to use them. Squeeze the grip to grab.
lines.spoken: Quick tour while it's quiet. Point your controller at things and pull the trigger to use them. Squeeze the grip to grab.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: First things first: grab your access badge from the desk. You'll need it to get around the building.
lines.spoken: First things first: grab your access badge from the desk. You'll need it to get around the building.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Hold on. The SIEM just raised a critical alert. Point at the red alert on your console and pull the trigger to open it.
lines.spoken: Hold on. The SIEM just raised a critical alert. Point at the red alert on your console and pull the trigger to open it.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Read the log lines carefully. Which machine is sending all that data out?
lines.spoken: Read the log lines carefully. Which machine is sending all that data out?

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Right, Fred's PC. Now, what kind of attack are we looking at?
lines.spoken: Right, Fred's PC. Now, what kind of attack are we looking at?

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: That's a data exfiltration in progress. Declare a critical incident so the response plan kicks in.
lines.spoken: That's a data exfiltration in progress. Declare a critical incident so the response plan kicks in.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Incident declared. Fred's office is on floor 3. Hold your badge against the reader by the door and go. I'll stay on the radio.
lines.spoken: Incident declared. Fred's office is on floor three. Hold your badge against the reader by the door and go. I'll stay on the radio.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Door's open. Go, and remember: every minute counts.
lines.spoken: Door's open. Go, and remember: every minute counts.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: You're in Fred's office. The attacker is still on his workstation, uploading Project AURORA. Contain it before the upload finishes.
lines.spoken: You're in Fred's office. The attacker is still on his workstation, uploading Project Aurora. Contain it before the upload finishes.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Every area you secure reveals one digit of the door code on the containment board.
lines.spoken: Every area you secure reveals one digit of the door code on the containment board.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Start with the obvious. His screen is unlocked and the attacker is live on it. Kill that session.
lines.spoken: Start with the obvious. His screen is unlocked and the attacker is live on it. Kill that session.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Someone printed something at 1:58 AM. Check the printer and bag that page as evidence.
lines.spoken: Someone printed something at one fifty eight A M. Check the printer and bag that page as evidence.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Attackers love rubbish bins. Check the waste bin for anything interesting.
lines.spoken: Attackers love rubbish bins. Check the waste bin for anything interesting.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: There are confidential papers lying on Fred's desk. Feed them to the shredder.
lines.spoken: There are confidential papers lying on Fred's desk. Feed them to the shredder.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Fred's briefcase is on the sideboard under the window. Open it and see what's inside.
lines.spoken: Fred's briefcase is on the sideboard under the window. Open it and see what's inside.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: To lock the attacker out, sign in as Fred. He loves using personal details. Have a look at his photo frame.
lines.spoken: To lock the attacker out, sign in as Fred. He loves using personal details. Have a look at his photo frame.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: You're in. Now set a strong new password. Follow the rules on the poster.
lines.spoken: You're in. Now set a strong new password. Follow the rules on the poster.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Turn on two-factor authentication. Fred's hardware token is in his briefcase.
lines.spoken: Turn on two factor authentication. Fred's hardware token is in his briefcase.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: His inbox is full of bait. Report every phishing email and keep the real ones.
lines.spoken: His inbox is full of bait. Report every phishing email and keep the real ones.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Someone is messaging Fred in TeamChat. Careful with this one.
lines.spoken: Someone is messaging Fred in Team Chat. Careful with this one.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Everything else is contained. Open the SOC console tab and encrypt Project AURORA.
lines.spoken: Everything else is contained. Open the SOC console tab and encrypt Project Aurora.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Brilliant. The containment board shows your override code. Enter it on the keypad by the door.
lines.spoken: Brilliant. The containment board shows your override code. Enter it on the keypad by the door.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: AURORA is encrypted and the attacker is locked out. But they got in from somewhere. Head down to the server room.
lines.spoken: Aurora is encrypted and the attacker is locked out. But they got in from somewhere. Head down to the server room.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Welcome to the server room. The attacker's traffic is still coming from inside this room. Something here doesn't belong.
lines.spoken: Welcome to the server room. The attacker's traffic is still coming from inside this room. Something here doesn't belong.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Walk along the racks and look for a device that isn't ours. Point at it and pull the trigger to inspect it.
lines.spoken: Walk along the racks and look for a device that isn't ours. Point at it and pull the trigger to inspect it.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: That's a rogue implant, a tiny computer someone planted in our rack. Pull out its network cable to cut the connection.
lines.spoken: That's a rogue implant, a tiny computer someone planted in our rack. Pull out its network cable to cut the connection.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Now grab the implant and put it in the evidence bag on the cart. Forensics will want it.
lines.spoken: Now grab the implant and put it in the evidence bag on the cart. Forensics will want it.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Let's make sure nothing else on that segment is infected. On the switch console, move the port to the quarantine VLAN.
lines.spoken: Let's make sure nothing else on that segment is infected. On the switch console, move the port to the quarantine V LAN.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: The file server was tampered with tonight. Restore it from the last clean backup, from before the breach at 1:58.
lines.spoken: The file server was tampered with tonight. Restore it from the last clean backup, from before the breach at one fifty eight.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Last thing. File the incident report at the terminal. Be honest about what went wrong.
lines.spoken: Last thing. File the incident report at the terminal. Be honest about what went wrong.

lines.speaker: Maya (SOC lead)
lines.text: Report filed. Incident closed. You contained a real breach on your very first night. Welcome to the team.
lines.spoken: Report filed. Incident closed. You contained a real breach on your very first night. Welcome to the team.
